about: Cinder Warden tree rework (v81s, staging trial). Points go into trees, not single skills. Every 5 points in a tree unlocks its next skill (8 per tree, the 8th at 40 is the ultimate). Each point between unlocks adds that tree's bonus to every skill in it. Points 41-50 add damage only. Tuning lives here; js/ab-skilltree.js reads it. Names with kotoPlaceholder: true are placeholders for Koto (see KOTO-NAMES.md). Delete this file (or set enabled false) and the Warden uses the old per-skill system again.

points.about: Tree points: 1 at level 1, +1 per level to 50 (50), plus 1 every 5 Paragon levels (20 by Paragon 100). 70 total. Points are derived from level and Paragon, so they can never exceed 70.

rank.about: Rank of every unlocked skill in a tree = round(min(points,40) / perRank), at least 1, at most max. 40 points maxes a tree's skills (rank 20). Points past 40 do not raise rank. Gear +skills only adds to skills that are already unlocked.

damageBand.about: Points 41-50: damage only (+pct per point to that tree's skills). No rank, area, stat or utility gain.

trees.name: Brand
trees.about: Heavy steel and fire strikes: cleaves, a dash, a hook, and burning combos.

trees.name: Ember
trees.about: Kiln fire, wards and explosions: coals at range, a ward, and room-clearing blasts.

trees.name: Warden
trees.about: Armor, retaliation and a last stand: turn defense into counter-damage.

upgrades.about: Tree-mode upgrades to existing Warden skills (only while the tree system is on).

kiln_hook.about: Also pulls what it hits toward you.

ash_skin.about: Also raises all resists a little per rank.

skills.name: Forgebreaker
skills.about: Your melee hits crack enemy armor, and every 4th melee hit is a sure critical strike.
notes: Cracked armor makes the target easier to hit for a few seconds.

skills.name: Furnace Flurry
skills.about: Three fast cuts, then the heat in them bursts around you.
notes: Each cut is a melee hit, so Forgebreaker counts all three.

skills.name: Avatar of the Kiln
skills.about: Ultimate. Become the kiln for 12 seconds: faster attacks, Brand cuts swing all the way around you, and every hit splashes fire.
notes: Splash fire hits foes near the one you struck.

skills.name: Slag Rain
skills.about: Lob burning coals at range. They burst, then leave scorched ground for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Ash Detonation
skills.about: When Ash Ward breaks or ends, it bursts like Cinder Bloom. Foes you burned explode when they die.
notes: Death bursts are capped so a pack cannot chain forever.

skills.name: Heart of the Sunken Kiln
skills.about: Ultimate. Fire crits hit for 1.75x, your fire ignores 25 of a foe's fire resist, and every 3rd Ember skill you cast fires a free, wider Cinder Bloom.

skills.name: Iron Reply
skills.about: When a foe hits you in melee, you strike back for damage based on your total armor.
notes: Warden tree damage bonuses raise this too.

skills.name: Life-Spite Bulwark
skills.about: Pay 20% of your current life for a shield worth 2.5x what you paid, plus armor while it holds.
notes: A safe way to drop under 40% life for Unbroken Bastion.

skills.name: Unbroken Bastion
skills.about: Ultimate. 35% of your armor becomes weapon damage. Below 40% life, Iron Reply hits twice as hard and you attack twice as fast.
notes: Armor turns into damage at 1 damage per 10 armor converted.

strings.allUnlocked: All 8 unlocked. Points 41–50 add damage only.
strings.noPoints: No points to spend. One comes with each level.
strings.oneUltimate: Only one tree can reach its ultimate.
strings.notice: Skill trees updated. All your points are ready to spend.
strings.noticeShort: Skill trees updated: points refunded free.

spellBookHook.about: Next phase. ABTree.replaceTree(player, slotIndex, treeId) swaps one of the 3 tree slots for another tree def (registered with ABTree.registerTree) and resets every tree point for free. Not reachable from the game yet.
